product_summary: Geniemode is a B2B sourcing/supply-chain platform (founded 2021, HQ Gurgaon, offices New York & Barcelona), not a food/FMCG producer. Its own published specialties are: apparel sourcing, fashion & accessories sourcing, home textile sourcing, furniture sourcing, home decor sourcing, hardgoods sourcing, plus sampling, QC and logistics. LinkedIn industry tag: 'Retail Apparel and Fashion'. Core lines are therefore knitted and woven garments (T-shirts, shirts, dresses, knitwear), home textiles (bed/table linen, curtains), furniture, home decor and hardgoods. No food, beverage or FMCG line appears anywhere in the company's own self-description.
comment: HS comparison: PARTIAL. The four declared codes (610442, 610510, 610910, 611020) are all legitimate knitted-garment headings and are consistent with the apparel side of the business — 610910 (cotton T-shirts) and 611020 (cotton pullovers) are the most plausible core lines for an India apparel exporter. However the declaration covers only knitted tops/knitwear and omits the majority of the company's stated product scope: woven garments (6203/6204/6205/6206), home textiles (6302/6303/6304), furniture (9403/9404) and home decor/hardgoods (9405, 9503, 3924, 6912, 7323). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground — company is retained and the code list is corrected/extended to the actual range. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is wrong — no food or FMCG product line is evidenced; the correct industry is apparel / home textiles / home decor & hardgoods sourcing. ROLE: trader/platform aggregator, not a manufacturer — the company describes itself as aggregating local/global suppliers and managing sampling, manufacturing coordination, QC and logistics; it is a sourcing intermediary, so role_hint = trader (possibly manufacturer_trader for private-label programmes, but no owned-factory evidence was found). EVIDENCE LIMITS: geniemode.com is a JavaScript-only single-page app and returned no readable product text; sitemap.xml likewise returned only the JS shell; DuckDuckGo and Bing returned bot-challenge/irrelevant results, so no category or catalogue page could be read. The product list above is sourced from the company's own LinkedIn profile 'Specialties' and 'About us' fields (linkedin.com/company/geniemode), not from a catalogue page. No customs line, B/L or shipment record was examined in this task (out of scope), therefore every product line here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — declared on the company's own profile, not corroborated by a customs record. No revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment figures are asserted; all such fields are null.
